name: Saotome Renji
source:
Kaoru's other close friend. He's not especially handsome, but he's got a confident personality, and doesn't have a problem finding girls to date. He likes cute girls, and doesn't really care much about them as long as they're cute.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yin-Yang!_X-Change_Alternative]Wikipedia[/url]]
